description: Pair-level scan configuration for Sonic mainnet. Wave 8 question: does Sonic — Fantom successor with mature DeFi ecosystem — contain a Ramses-class arbitrage surface? The Shadow Exchange CL (Ramses V3 fork) is a natural dominant-venue candidate; Shadow V2 (Solidly fork) is a natural tracking-venue candidate. Discovery will measure active-tick depths and report. Constitutional discipline: discovery runs regardless of external data signals.

pairs.label: wS/USDC
pairs.note: Primary Sonic pair. Token sort: wS (0x039e) < USDC (0x29219dd4) → token0=wS, token1=USDC. priceMode='normal' (price = USDC/wS = wS price in USD ≈ $0.50 as of Jun 2026). Same orientation as Base ETH/USDC. Probes use default --stable-side 1 (USDC=token1).

pairs.label: wS/USDC.e
pairs.note: Secondary pair using bridged USDC.e variant. Token sort: wS (0x039e) < USDC.e (0x0BA304) → token0=wS, token1=USDC.e. priceMode='normal'. May be deprecated by Circle native USDC; depth comparison via Step 4 discovery will inform Step 5 probe decision.
